verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a cursor, delta, or 'continue' endpoint that returns only changes since the last call. The SDK snippet shows only a plain filesListFolder listing. The webhook change notifications belong to a separate story and do not show incremental delta retrieval, so they cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl
